author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the keyboard map, notes lasting one, two and three beats, song shape and a left-hand waltz, using a bicycle song.

classes.title: Downhill on the bicycle
classes.goal: Find the hand position and hear the first line ride downhill from high C to low C.

mathTarget.parentLine: High notes on the right, low notes on the left

classes.parentPrompt: Draw a hill in the air with your child's finger, from high right to low left.
classes.childAction: Point to each Daisy note as it rides down the keys.
classes.bridge: Dai-sy, Dai-sy: four big wheels rolling downhill from right to left.

intro.caption: Ride downhill with Daisy
intro.parentCue: draw a hill in the air together

games.caption: Daisy, Daisy, downhill
games.parentCue: Point to each key as it lights

games.caption: Give me your answer, do
games.parentCue: Say two, three, four, two, four, one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: mapping high and low notes onto the keys.

classes.title: Same start, new road
classes.goal: Learn the second line and compare its ending with the first line's ending.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two lines start the same way, then take different roads

classes.parentPrompt: Play both endings and ask: 'Which one went home, which one climbed up?'
classes.childAction: Play D, E, F, then climb on: G, A, G.
classes.bridge: Both roads start D, E, F; one turns home, one rides up the hill.

games.caption: All for the love of you
games.parentCue: Say one, two, three, four, five, four

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: comparing two lines that start the same.

classes.title: A little wobble on black
classes.goal: Learn the middle lines, with a tiny step up onto a black key and back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Stepping to the next key and straight back again

classes.parentPrompt: Show the black key just right of A; say 'wob-ble' as your child steps on and off.
classes.childAction: Play A, the black key, then A again: a little wobble.
classes.bridge: The bicycle wobbles: step onto the black key, then straight back to A.

intro.caption: The bicycle wobbles
intro.parentCue: show the black key just right of A

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: stepping onto a black key and back.

classes.title: Two halves of the ride
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and hear its two halves: long calls, then quick chatter.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first half sings long notes; the second half chatters

classes.parentPrompt: Stretch your arms wide for the long first half; wiggle your fingers for the chattery second.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; tell your grown-up when the chatter half begins.
classes.bridge: First the bicycle glides with long notes, then the wheels go clickety-click.

intro.caption: Long notes, then chatter
intro.parentCue: ask your child when the halves change

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing the two halves of a song.

classes.title: One, two, three beats long
classes.goal: Practise 'give me your answer, do' slowly: notes that last one, two and three beats.

mathTarget.parentLine: Some notes last one beat, some two, some three

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' aloud and hold up fingers for how long each note lasts.
classes.childAction: Play slowly, holding each note for its number of beats.
classes.bridge: A one-beat note is a pedal push; a three-beat note is a long glide.

intro.caption: How long does it last?
intro.parentCue: hold up fingers for each note's beats

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: notes that last one, two and three beats.

classes.title: Oom-pah-pah, low note first
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar of three.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note, then two waits: oom, pah, pah

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'oom, pah, pah' aloud; your child plays the low note on every 'oom'.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays low F on 'oom', then waits two beats.
classes.bridge: Low notes live far left, like the big back wheel: oom, pah, pah.

intro.caption: Oom, pah, pah!
intro.parentCue: say it aloud while you play the tune

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one low note at the start of each bar.

classes.title: Two riders, one bicycle
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left-hand note at the start of each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: The left hand plays once while the right hand plays three

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three' slowly; tap your child's left hand on every 'one'.
classes.childAction: Left hand on 'one', right hand keeps the tune going.
classes.bridge: A bicycle built for two: one rider pedals low, one steers high.

intro.caption: Two hands, one bicycle
intro.parentCue: tap their left hand on every one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: using two hands with different jobs.

classes.title: Built for two
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going to the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, all the way to the end

classes.parentPrompt: Sing along beside your child and sway on each 'one'; if they slip, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep pedalling after a slip.
classes.bridge: Two riders pedal at the same speed, or the bicycle wobbles.

intro.caption: Hop on, it's built for two
intro.parentCue: sing beside your child and keep going

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: A waltz for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy with a gentle swaying waltz feel.

mathTarget.parentLine: Choosing a swaying, gentle way to play

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; sway together on each 'one', then clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play a swaying waltz for teddy, then bow.
classes.bridge: Lean into each 'one' like a bicycle leaning round a gentle bend.

intro.caption: A waltz for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a waltz feel.
